overview.purpose_zh: 这张图用来看月活跃读者在不同城市的分布：每个城市画一个圆，圆越大，读者越多。
works_zh: 适合比较不同城市的读者规模，尤其是跨区域的大城市。
适合看读者主要集中在哪些地区，以及哪些城市明显偏小。
uses_zh: 周报里的读者分布概览

understanding.read_zh: 先找最大的几个圆，看它们集中在哪个区域；再比较同一区域内城市之间的大小；圆与圆重叠时以标签为准，比较的是面积，不是直径。

elements.note_zh: 每个城市一个圆，圆面积与该城市的月活跃读者数成正比。
两个圆比大小时看面积；面积翻倍，半径并不会翻倍。
城市名写在圆旁边；东亚城市挨得近，重叠时以标签区分。
底图只标出城市位置，底图颜色深浅不代表数值大小。

look_for_zh: 最大的圆是否集中在同一个区域。
相邻城市的小圆是否被大圆盖住，读的时候要靠标签区分。
排在中间的城市之间差距有多大，是不是一个平滑的梯队。

observations.en: Shanghai leads with 1,420 thousand monthly readers, 110 more than Beijing.
observations.zh: 上海以 1,420 千名月活跃读者领先，比北京多 110 千名。

observations.en: Tokyo ranks third at 1,180, 130 behind Beijing.
observations.zh: 东京以 1,180 千名排在第三，落后北京 130 千名。

observations.en: New York is the largest city outside Asia, at 760, well ahead of London's 520.
observations.zh: 纽约是亚洲以外读者最多的城市，为 760 千名，明显高于伦敦的 520 千名。

observations.en: Seoul, Singapore and Mumbai fill the middle of the range, at 860, 640 and 590.
observations.zh: 首尔、新加坡和孟买处在中间位置，分别为 860、640 和 590 千名。

observations.en: Sydney has the smallest circle, at 310, roughly a fifth of Shanghai's total.
observations.zh: 悉尼的圆最小，为 310 千名，大约是上海总量的五分之一。

describe.en: The symbol map compares monthly reader numbers across ten cities, scaling each circle to that city's total.
describe.zh: 这张符号地图比较十座城市的月活跃读者人数，每个圆按该城市的总数缩放。
describe.pattern: The chart compares A across B
alternatives: The map compares reader figures for ten cities.
The chart shows monthly readers by city.
describe.note_zh: 开头先说图和比较对象，再进入具体数字。

describe.en: Shanghai is located in eastern China, and its circle is the largest on the map, at 1,420 thousand monthly readers.
describe.zh: 上海位于中国东部，它的圆是图上最大的，月活跃读者为 1,420 千名。
alternatives: Shanghai sits in eastern China and leads the map with 1,420 thousand readers.
Located in eastern China, Shanghai has the biggest circle at 1,420.
describe.note_zh: 先给位置，再给数值，读者就知道该看地图的哪一块。

describe.en: Shanghai leads at 1,420 thousand readers, closely followed by Beijing at 1,310.
describe.zh: 上海以 1,420 千名读者领先，北京以 1,310 千名紧随其后。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: Shanghai tops the map with 1,420, just ahead of Beijing at 1,310.
Shanghai leads, with Beijing close behind at 1,310.
describe.note_zh: 两地只差 110，用 closely 才准确；差距大就只能用 followed by。

describe.en: Tokyo has twice as many monthly readers as Mumbai, 1,180 against 590.
describe.zh: 东京的月活跃读者是孟买的两倍，1,180 对 590。
describe.pattern: A + have + twice as many + plural noun + as + B
alternatives: Tokyo's 1,180 thousand readers are exactly twice Mumbai's 590.
Mumbai has half as many readers as Tokyo, 590 against 1,180.
describe.note_zh: 读者是可数的人，所以用 twice as many as，不用 as much as。

describe.en: The most noticeable feature is the cluster of large circles in East Asia: Shanghai, Beijing and Tokyo hold 1,420, 1,310 and 1,180 thousand readers.
describe.zh: 最引人注意的是东亚聚集的大圆：上海、北京和东京分别有 1,420、1,310 和 1,180 千名读者。
describe.pattern: The most noticeable feature is + noun phrase
alternatives: What stands out is the group of large circles in East Asia.
The clearest pattern is the East Asian cluster at the top of the range.
describe.note_zh: 概括时点出成组的特征，比逐个念城市更有信息量。

describe.en: Tokyo, Shanghai and Beijing recorded 1,180, 1,420 and 1,310 thousand readers respectively.
describe.zh: 东京、上海和北京的读者人数分别是 1,180、1,420 和 1,310 千名。
describe.pattern: A, B and C + verb + X, Y and Z + respectively
alternatives: The three East Asian cities recorded 1,180, 1,420 and 1,310 respectively.
Readers in Tokyo, Shanghai and Beijing stood at 1,180, 1,420 and 1,310 respectively.
describe.note_zh: respectively 要求城市和数字的顺序一一对应，顺序写错就会张冠李戴。

describe.en: Sydney's 310 thousand readers are roughly a fifth of Shanghai's 1,420.
describe.zh: 悉尼的 310 千名读者大约是上海 1,420 千名的五分之一。
alternatives: At 310, Sydney has roughly one-fifth of Shanghai's readers.
Sydney's circle is about a fifth of the size of Shanghai's.
describe.note_zh: 分数用文字写，和 roughly 搭配最自然。

academic.en: The symbol map plots monthly reader numbers for ten cities, with the area of each circle proportional to that city's total. East Asia accounts for the upper end of the distribution: Shanghai records 1,420 thousand monthly readers, Beijing 1,310 and Tokyo 1,180, while Seoul adds 860. Outside Asia, New York is the largest city at 760, ahead of London at 520 and Paris at 430. Sydney has the smallest circle, at 310. The gap between Shanghai and Beijing is 110 thousand readers; between Shanghai and Sydney it is 1,110.
academic.zh: 这张符号地图画出十座城市的月活跃读者人数，每个圆的面积与该城市的总数成正比。东亚占据了分布的高端：上海 1,420 千名，北京 1,310 千名，东京 1,180 千名，首尔另有 860 千名。亚洲以外，纽约以 760 千名居首，高于伦敦的 520 千名和巴黎的 430 千名。悉尼的圆最小，为 310 千名。上海与北京相差 110 千名，上海与悉尼相差 1,110 千名。

business.en: Shanghai is our strongest market, with 1,420 thousand monthly readers and a lead of 110 over Beijing, so the two mainland cities should anchor the regional plan. East Asia is where the audience is: Tokyo adds 1,180 and Seoul 860, and their circles sit close together on the map. New York, at 760, is the best entry point outside Asia, well ahead of London at 520. Sydney, at 310, is the smallest market, so a local push there needs a tighter budget than the mainland cities.
business.zh: 上海是我们最强的市场，月活跃读者 1,420 千名，领先北京 110 千名，因此区域计划应以这两座内地城市为支柱。东亚是读者最集中的地方：东京另有 1,180 千名，首尔 860 千名，它们在图上的圆挨得很近。纽约以 760 千名成为亚洲以外最好的切入点，明显高于伦敦的 520 千名。悉尼以 310 千名排在最后，当地推广的预算要比内地城市更紧。

simple.en: Each circle is one city. A bigger circle means more monthly readers. Shanghai has the most, with 1,420 thousand readers. Beijing is next, with 1,310. Tokyo is third, at 1,180. Sydney has the fewest, at 310. The biggest circles are all in East Asia.
simple.zh: 每个圆代表一座城市。圆越大，月活跃读者越多。上海最多，有 1,420 千名读者。北京其次，有 1,310 千名。东京第三，为 1,180 千名。悉尼最少，只有 310 千名。最大的几个圆都在东亚。

language_notes.title_en: twice as many, not twice as much
language_notes.body_zh: 读者是可数的人，倍数要用 twice as many as；钱、时间、运量这类不可数量才用 twice as much as。图里东京正好是孟买的两倍，这句话只能用 many。
examples: Tokyo has twice as many monthly readers as Mumbai, 1,180 against 590.
Shanghai has more readers than any other city, 1,420 against 1,310.

language_notes.body_zh: 报数值时，at 后面跟一个具体水平，with 后面跟某个地方拥有的数量。Shanghai sits at 1,420 强调图上的读数，Shanghai leads with 1,420 强调它凭这个数领先。两种都常见，但不要说 Shanghai is 1,420。
examples: Shanghai sits at 1,420 thousand monthly readers.
Shanghai leads the map with 1,420 thousand monthly readers.

language_notes.title_en: proportional to the area, not the radius
language_notes.body_zh: 符号地图靠面积表示大小，描述时说 the area is proportional to the value。不要说 the radius is proportional to，因为半径翻倍会让面积变成四倍，读者会误判。
examples: The area of each circle is proportional to the city's monthly readers.
Shanghai's 1,420 readers produce the largest circle on the map.
